name: Diigo

sources.title: Diigo homepage — free signup, social bookmarking/annotation platform, 9M+ users
Diigo signup (JS-rendered; returned empty HTML at fetch)

requirements: A free Diigo account ('Try it free Now')
Diigo is a social bookmarking/research platform — the 'listing' is a public bookmark of your product URL with tags and annotations
preparation: Product URL plus a set of relevant tags
A short annotation/description for the bookmark
workflow: Sign up at diigo.com/sign-up (JS-rendered — needs a JS-capable agent or manual step)
Optionally install the Diigo browser extension from diigo.com/tools
Bookmark the product URL publicly, add tags and a description/annotation
Optionally add the link to a public Group or Outliner collection
Verify the public bookmark/profile page renders to logged-out visitors
watchFor: This is a bookmarking surface, not a curated directory — a single bare bookmark has minimal discovery value; Groups and tags drive visibility
Premium features exist (e.g., archived web pages is a paid feature); the free tier is enough for the bookmark
Signup page is JS-only — direct POST automation may be needed
Spam-looking bulk bookmarking risks account action
countsAsLive: The public bookmark appears on your public Diigo profile/library (and in tag/group pages) reachable without login
unknowns: Whether Diigo profile/bookmark outbound links are dofollow
Whether new accounts' bookmarks are publicly indexable immediately
